title: Board Proximity Connect
description: Implement proximity connect: when dragging a node with no incident edges, overlapping another node's bounds shows a wire between nearest compatible handles (normal/detail/micro LOD only); release commits edge. Disabled in minimap and overview LOD.
summary: BoardHost now refuses link gestures that would use a handle that already has an incident edge: try_commit_link_edge guards both endpoints, nearest_link_snap_handle_world skips busy targets, LinkTargetNode completion ignores busy handles, and LinkAtSourceHandle does not start from a busy handle. Added Rust scene helpers and host_tests for busy target/source/indirect. Fixed elements_board Cargo.toml missing base64 for tests. Vitest: use detail-band camera zoom for WASM link-drag tests (snap requires detail LOD), align nodeCreate expectation with graph observation, BoardCanvas tests pass BOARD_LOD_DETAIL_MIN_ZOOM via camera prop.
